cues.say: AI is moving out of the cloud, and onto your own computer.
cues.caption: AI is moving out of the cloud | and onto your own computer.

cues.say: But the electric bill is yours too.
cues.caption: But the electric bill is yours too.

cues.say: How much power does your AI really use?
cues.caption: How much power does your AI really use?

cues.say: It runs entirely on your machine.
cues.caption: It runs entirely on your machine.

cues.say: No cloud, no account, no extra hardware.
cues.caption: No cloud, no account, no extra hardware.

cues.say: Every two seconds, it reads your computer's own power sensors.
cues.caption: Every two seconds, it reads | your computer's own power sensors.

cues.say: That total is measured, not guessed.
cues.caption: That total is measured, not guessed.

cues.say: Then it splits that power between your AI apps, by how much CPU and GPU each one uses.
cues.caption: Then it splits that power between your AI apps, | by how much CPU and GPU each one uses.

cues.say: Anything without a sensor is estimated, and always labeled.
cues.caption: Anything without a sensor is estimated, | and always labeled.

cues.say: And you can check it against a wall meter.
cues.caption: And you can check it against a wall meter.

cues.say: Watts become kilowatt hours, pesos, and carbon.
cues.caption: Watts become kilowatt-hours, pesos, and carbon.

cues.say: It forecasts your bill, and one click swaps a heavy model for a lighter one.
cues.caption: It forecasts your bill, and one click | swaps a heavy model for a lighter one.

cues.say: Watt Trace. Measured, not guessed. Local, not cloud.
cues.caption: WattTrace. Measured, not guessed. | Local, not cloud.
